panels.title: AI Spend in Range & Fleet Overview

panels.description: LLM spend over the dashboard's time range. Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: Direct Cloud Spend in Range

panels.description: Equivalent cloud spend avoided by local model execution over the dashboard's time range. The local prompt and completion tokens of each operation are priced at the hosted reference price that the dashboard constant reference_price_usd_per_token holds for them, so every process and every range is priced at one reference (#1672, #2194). A series from before the local label that the gateway served counts as local, because the gateway serves only local models, and a series from before the operation label counts as chat. Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: Local Cloud Savings in Range

targets.expr: sum((label_replace(sum by (type) (increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{local="true", operation!="embeddings"}[$__range]) or increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{local="", provider="gateway", server!="cache", operation!="embeddings"}[$__range])), "operation", "chat", "", "") or sum by (operation, type) (increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{local="true", operation="embeddings"}[$__range]) or increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{local="", provider="gateway", server!="cache", operation="embeddings"}[$__range]))) * on (operation, type) group_left () (${reference_price_usd_per_token:raw})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Model calls over the dashboard's time range, from every caller. A call through the gateway is counted once, from the gateway's own series: its chat and embedding requests that got a reply (status 2xx), whoever sent them. devops-cli's own series add only its calls that did not go through the gateway. Replies the response cache answered are not model calls, and Response Cache Hit Share shows them; Gateway Attempts by Status shows the attempts that failed (#1668). Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: AI Requests in Range

targets.expr: (sum(increase(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{route=~"/v1/(chat/completions|embeddings)", status_code=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(devops_cli_ai_requests_total{provider!="gateway", cached="false"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.description: Prompt and completion tokens of model calls over the dashboard's time range, from every caller. Tokens of a call through the gateway come from the gateway's own series, whoever sent the call; devops-cli's own series add only the tokens of its calls that did not go through the gateway, without the cache's replies and without reasoning tokens, which the completion tokens hold (#1668). Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
panels.title: Tokens Processed in Range

targets.expr: (sum(increase(litellm_total_tokens_metric_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(devops_cli_ai_tokens_total{provider!="gateway", server!="cache", type!="reasoning"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.description: LLM calls and embedding requests per second by operation and model, replies the response cache answered included.
panels.title: Request Rate by Model

panels.description: Share of the last hour's LLM calls the response cache answered, embedding requests left out; an hour with calls and no cache answers shows 0. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The counts lost can fall on either side of the ratio, so a share can come out high or low.
panels.title: Response Cache Hit Share

panels.description: The 95th percentile of the time a call to Ollama waited in its process for a slot on one of its nodes, over the last hour, by priority (high, normal or as_available), with the count of calls that asked for a slot on the right axis. A call that timed out counts at the wait it had. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The counts lost can fall in any bucket, so a quantile can come out high or low.
panels.title: Ollama Slot Wait by Priority (p95)

panels.description: The gateway's chat and embedding requests per hour, by HTTP status, from every caller. A status other than 2xx is a failed attempt: 408 a timeout, 499 a caller that closed the request, 5xx a failure of the gateway or its backend. devops-cli's own series count only the calls that got a reply (#1668).
panels.title: Gateway Attempts by Status

panels.description: The gateway's requests per hour that got a reply, and their tokens on the right axis, by the end user that each request names. devops-cli names its OTel service: devops-cli, devops-cli-job or roadmap-service. A caller that names no end user, such as Open WebUI or an editor extension, shows as unnamed (#1668).
panels.title: Gateway Requests and Tokens by Caller

panels.description: devops-cli's own count of its gateway calls that got a reply, as a share of all the gateway's replied chat and embedding requests over the dashboard's time range. The rest came from other callers, or from devops-cli calls whose telemetry did not arrive; Gateway Requests and Tokens by Caller tells them apart (#1668). Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). The counts lost can fall on either side of the ratio, so a share can come out high or low.
panels.title: devops-cli Coverage of Gateway Requests

list.description: The hosted price of one local token in USD, by operation and token type: genai-prices' price of `gpt-4o` for chat and of `text-embedding-3-small` for embeddings, the default reference models of devops-cli, written as USD per million tokens. The savings queries multiply the local tokens by it, and put it in with the raw format, so Grafana does not escape its quotes. tests/test_k8s_monitoring_dashboards.py fails when a price differs from genai-prices.
list.label: Reference price (USD per token)
list.name: reference_price_usd_per_token
list.query: label_replace(label_replace(vector(2.5 / 1e6), "operation", "chat", "", ""), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(10 / 1e6), "operation", "chat", "", ""), "type", "completion", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0.02 / 1e6), "operation", "embeddings", "", ""), "type", "prompt", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0 / 1e6), "operation", "embeddings", "", ""), "type", "completion", "", "")
